label: Figure 5.8: The total product curve
alt: Total product curve rising at an increasing rate up to 5 workers, then at a decreasing rate, flattening towards 100 bicycles a week at 10 workers.
caption: Adding workers to a fixed workshop, total product rises at first at an increasing rate, reaching 50 bicycles a week with 5 workers. After that it keeps rising but more and more slowly (diminishing returns), flattening out at 100 bicycles a week with 10 workers.
